headline: A 2018 law names an existing memorial at the National Teachers Hall of Fame in Emporia, Kansas, the "National Memorial to Fallen Educators."
what_it_does: The law gives an existing memorial in Emporia, Kansas, the official name "National Memorial to Fallen Educators." The memorial is not part of the National Park System. The law does not allow or require any federal money to be spent on the memorial.
when_it_takes_effect: The summary does not give a separate date, so it appears to have taken effect when it was signed into law on April 30, 2018.
